mapper.sql: id, source_type, owner_user_id, name, meal_time, mood, scene, health_goal, cuisine, taste, convenience, energy_kcal, protein_g, fat_g, carbohydrate_g, fiber_g, sodium_mg, allergens, nutrition_source, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO meal_item ( source_type, owner_user_id, name, meal_time, mood, scene, health_goal, cuisine, taste, convenience, energy_kcal, protein_g, fat_g, carbohydrate_g, fiber_g, sodium_mg, allergens, nutrition_source, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{sourceType}, #{ownerUserId}, #{name}, #{mealTime}, #{mood}, #{scene}, #{healthGoal}, #{cuisine}, #{taste}, #{convenience}, #{energyKcal}, #{proteinG}, #{fatG}, #{carbohydrateG}, #{fiberG}, #{sodiumMg}, #{allergens}, #{nutritionSource}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE meal_item SET name = #{name}, meal_time = #{mealTime}, mood = #{mood}, scene = #{scene}, health_goal = #{healthGoal}, cuisine = #{cuisine}, taste = #{taste}, convenience = #{convenience}, energy_kcal = #{energyKcal}, protein_g = #{proteinG}, fat_g = #{fatG}, carbohydrate_g = #{carbohydrateG}, fiber_g = #{fiberG}, sodium_mg = #{sodiumMg}, allergens = #{allergens}, nutrition_source = #{nutritionSource}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND source_type = 'PERSONAL' AND owner_user_id = #{ownerUserId}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM meal_item WHERE id = #{id} AND ( (source_type = 'PUBLIC' AND owner_user_id IS NULL) OR (source_type = 'PERSONAL' AND owner_user_id = #{userId}) )
SELECT FROM meal_item WHERE source_type = 'PERSONAL' AND owner_user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY updated_at DESC
SELECT FROM meal_item WHERE source_type = 'PUBLIC' AND owner_user_id IS NULL ORDER BY updated_at DESC
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM meal_item WHERE source_type = 'PERSONAL' AND owner_user_id = #{userId}

SELECT FROM meal_item m
m.source_type = 'PERSONAL' AND m.owner_user_id = #{userId}
m.source_type = 'PUBLIC' AND m.owner_user_id IS NULL
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM meal_slot_tag tag WHERE tag.meal_id = m.id AND tag.slot_name = 'mealTime' AND tag.tag_value IN #{value})
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM meal_slot_tag tag WHERE tag.meal_id = m.id AND tag.slot_name = 'mood' AND tag.tag_value IN #{value})
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM meal_slot_tag tag WHERE tag.meal_id = m.id AND tag.slot_name = 'scene' AND tag.tag_value IN #{value})
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM meal_slot_tag tag WHERE tag.meal_id = m.id AND tag.slot_name = 'healthGoal' AND tag.tag_value IN #{value})
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM meal_slot_tag tag WHERE tag.meal_id = m.id AND tag.slot_name = 'cuisine' AND tag.tag_value IN #{value})
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM meal_slot_tag tag WHERE tag.meal_id = m.id AND tag.slot_name = 'taste' AND tag.tag_value IN #{value})
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM meal_slot_tag tag WHERE tag.meal_id = m.id AND tag.slot_name = 'convenience' AND tag.tag_value IN #{value})
AND (#{maxEnergyKcal} IS NULL OR (m.energy_kcal IS NOT NULL AND m.energy_kcal <= #{maxEnergyKcal})) AND (#{minProteinG} IS NULL OR (m.protein_g IS NOT NULL AND m.protein_g >= #{minProteinG})) AND (#{maxFatG} IS NULL OR (m.fat_g IS NOT NULL AND m.fat_g <= #{maxFatG})) AND (#{maxCarbohydrateG} IS NULL OR (m.carbohydrate_g IS NOT NULL AND m.carbohydrate_g <= #{maxCarbohydrateG})) AND (#{maxSodiumMg} IS NULL OR (m.sodium_mg IS NOT NULL AND m.sodium_mg <= #{maxSodiumMg})) AND ( #{excludedAllergensJson} = '[]' OR (m.allergens IS NOT NULL AND NOT JSON_OVERLAPS(m.allergens, #{excludedAllergensJson})) )
ORDER BY m.updated_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}
